CheckTitle: Check if S3 buckets have server access logging enabled
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that S3 server access logging is enabled on buckets.
Risk: Without access logs, unauthorized data access or exfiltration from a bucket cannot be investigated.

Recommendation.Text: Enable server access logging to a dedicated, access-restricted logging bucket.

Notes: CIS AWS 3.0 3.4 requires access logging on the CloudTrail bucket; this check evaluates every bucket.
